prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create a FINISHED display advertisement supplied by an independent advertiser, not a photograph for a web page, not a website component or card. The finished raster includes its own complete brand identity, campaign typography, artwork, persuasive copy and a prominent call-to-action drawn into the advertisement. All requested Italian wording must be exact and highly legible. Professional real-world ad agency art direction. Use only the brief's copy; no fake prices, discounts, deadlines or added claims. No weather-site branding or shared weather palette. No outer frame or watermark. Make the entire canvas the single ad; no grid of options, no mockup screen.
Format: COMPACT BANNER 300×100, wide ratio 3:1. Generate this compact short landscape canvas.
Input image 1: chapter C03 identity reference: red #c00000, black, white, crisp Swiss editorial grid.
Creative concept: purely graphic typographic university course-material advertisement, entirely different from photographic ads. White field divided into a large solid red square at left with the brand in white, and precise black text on white at right; a slim red CTA bar along the lower right. Minimal abstract black wireframe arrows and a single red selection dot as secondary detail. Sharp square geometry, strong whitespace, editorial sans type. Every word readable at 300×100. No photograph or realistic desk.
Text verbatim: left brand "LAB UX"; headline on right "Dalla ricerca al prototipo."; CTA "Apri i materiali". Nothing else. No navy, orange, lime or café styling.
